03 — BEFORE YOU SIGN

Six things we check before you sign.

Six points we put in writing on every Paris lease.

I
The rent capencadrement des loyers

The lease must state the reference rent and cannot exceed the increased reference without a justified complément. We run the check.

II
Who may charge youloi Hoguet · ALUR

A chasseur immobilier needs a carte professionnelle; agent fees to tenants are capped by law. We open with a licensed partner.

III
The depositdépôt de garantie

One month's rent unfurnished, two furnished, by law. Agents still ask for more, or months in advance. We don't let them.

IV
Lease typevide · meublé · mobilité

Unfurnished, furnished or bail mobilité: each sets notice, deposit and rights. We check which you're handed, and which charges are yours.

V
Proof of addressjustificatif de domicile

Bank, prefecture and school ask for it first. We make sure your lease serves as one from day one.

VI
Income rulesgarant · Visale

Payslips, tax notice, a French guarantor — or Visale, the state guarantee, for many under 30 and new hires. We write the dossier so it passes.

We'll also tell you what's wrong with it.

A tenancy that goes wrong costs us more than a lost fee — so we write down what we saw, before you sign.

⚑asking rent above the encadrement ⚑a bail mobilité for a long stay ⚑a deposit above the legal cap ⚑an agent fee charged to you
04 — QUESTIONS

The questions we get asked.

Why isn't BOOM taking searches in Paris yet?
Searching on a client's behalf is regulated in France: a chasseur immobilier needs a carte professionnelle (loi Hoguet). We open with a licensed partner rather than work around the rule. Your file waits, ready; you hear from us the day the desk opens.
What can you do for me today?
Open your file, answer your questions the same working day, and tell you honestly what your budget buys in Paris. The rent-cap check and the lease read are services of the desk: we say exactly what they cost when it opens.
Is my rent capped in Paris?
Paris applies the encadrement des loyers: the lease must state the reference rent, and the asking rent cannot exceed the increased reference without a justified complément. An asking rent above the cap is leverage, not a given.
Do I need to be in Paris?
No. When the desk opens, a BOOM person attends viewings in your place, with live video and a written report. The lease is read and signed remotely. You arrive for the keys and the état des lieux.
What does an agent legally charge a tenant in France?
The fees a letting agent may charge a tenant are capped by law, per square metre. An agent you hire, who works only for you, is a different, licensed service. That is why we open with a licensed partner, and never take landlord money.
What do you do with my data?
It is used to answer you and to open your file, and for nothing else. No resale, no mailing lists. Ask us to delete it and we will.
